images.label: 战术写实游戏
images.prompt:
Use case: game art direction, IN-GAME GAMEPLAY VIEW concept.
Generate ONE independent 16:9 landscape image that looks like a frame captured while PLAYING a finished real-time 3D third-person cooperative tactical shooter on a PC. This must feel like an actual interactive video game with authored 3D meshes, modular level geometry, runtime material shaders, gameplay camera and HUD. NOT a movie still, animation-film frame, painted illustration, promotional key art, character presentation, posed showcase, 2D drawing, or cinematic concept painting.
LOCKED GAMEPLAY COMPOSITION: camera about 2.5 meters behind and a little above the player's RIGHT shoulder, looking down a playable maintenance hall. Player avatar occupies the lower LEFT quarter, back/three-quarter rear view with head, torso and legs visible down toward the bottom edge; face is not shown. Avatar is actively aiming a rifle forward while moving out from waist-high cover, practical pale chest/shoulder armor over dark teal work clothes, orange shoulder strap, compact backpack. Camera belongs to this controllable avatar, not to a film crew. A small crosshair at screen center. A tiny minimal health/armor display bottom-left and a restrained ammunition HUD bottom-right displaying '24 / 96'; small white contextual 'E' interaction badge above a power terminal near the right side. HUD is secondary, clean and credible, no giant titles or card frames.
PLAYABLE LEVEL: a human-built rectilinear maintenance hall inside a larger ancient nonhuman facility. Walkable floor with manufactured panels, waist-high utility-crate cover in left/middle ground, clear lanes and sightline, door frames, overhead beams and useful pipes. A smooth ancient ceramic structural rib is visible behind the human engineering, but NO Gothic cathedral, medieval stone blocks, carved temple or endless mural detail. Actual room distances about 5-25 meters, grounded familiar human scale, not an enormous empty diorama. The right wall has a powered terminal and a heavy door with a small amber state lamp; a friendly deployable tripod turret points toward the enemies beside a cover block.
ACTION: one helmeted teammate about 10 meters ahead left-center takes cover and fires a short restrained burst. One original hostile organic quadruped about 8 meters ahead RIGHT-center is lunging low toward the player, pale dorsal plates over dark sinewy flesh and a small amber throat weakpoint; its silhouette and feet are clearly readable. Another enemy of the same species is further back near the far doorway, distinguishable and correctly smaller with distance. Player, teammate and both enemies look naturally placed and scaled within the same playable space. Aim direction, threat direction and cover relationship make sense. Modest localized impact sparks only, no explosions that obscure the view.
RENDERING COMMON REQUIREMENTS: this is real-time 3D rasterized game art. Credible physically modelled perspective, clean material separation, normal-mapped detail appropriate to each style, clearly visible game asset geometry, environment edges and texture density. Main gameplay subjects and background are in focus; no cinematic depth of field, no artistic bokeh, no letterboxing, no painterly postprocess pasted over the screenshot. Use enough ambient fill to navigate dark areas. No splash-art poses. Deliberate readable art direction at actual gameplay scale. Original designs, no franchise logos or copied characters.
SPECIFIC GAME ART STYLE:
Grounded high-fidelity tactical sci-fi GAME graphics. Realistic human scale, PBR painted armor, rubber grips, textured fabric, industrial steel panels, convincing but economical wear, contact shadows and practical overhead fluorescent light. Restrained desaturated steel and off-white palette with functional amber status lights. Enemy is realistically shaded organic tissue and mineral-like shell. Polished playable PC/console shooter screenshot, not live action. Favor crisp assets, readable midtones, stable shadows and authored modular level geometry over film grain or photographic spectacle.
